title: Smoked Chicken Fajitas
description: Quick and flavorful fajitas made with smoked chicken, broccoli, and a hint of Mexican spices.
instructions: Heat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of olive oil and cook the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
While the chicken cooks, toss the broccoli with the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil and lightly smoked fajita seasoning.
Add the broccoli to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until tender.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the fajitas by placing a portion of the chicken and broccoli onto a tortilla and serving.
